enc.drogas.plant.cannabis.name: Cannabis
enc.drogas.plant.cannabis.text: Serrated-leaf shrub. Prefers temperate climate, strong light and moist farmland. Vigorous plants yield more and better quality.
enc.drogas.plant.poppy.name: Poppy
enc.drogas.plant.poppy.text: Hardy pod flower: tolerates temperate or arid climate and medium light. The ripe pod is the raw material of the whole opioid line.
enc.drogas.plant.tobacco.name: Tobacco
enc.drogas.plant.tobacco.text: Broad leaves that need water nearby and strong light. After harvest the leaf must be cured in the dryer.
enc.drogas.plant.psilocybin.name: Magic Mushrooms
enc.drogas.plant.psilocybin.text: Shade culture: grows on substrate (mycelium, podzol, mud, moss or Organic Substrate), in the dark and humid. Sunlight kills it.
enc.drogas.plant.coca.name: Coca
enc.drogas.plant.coca.text: Demanding: strong light and humid climate. Outside jungles it grows very slowly. In an active greenhouse any biome works.
enc.drogas.plant.jagube.name: Jagube
enc.drogas.plant.jagube.text: Climbing vine: the base grows on farmland near water and, given support (trellis, wall or log), climbs forming branches harvested with right-click.
enc.drogas.plant.chacrona.name: Chacrona
enc.drogas.plant.chacrona.text: Half-shade shrub that grows on ordinary soil and likes humidity. Its leaves are the basis of the brew and extracts.
enc.drogas.equip.processing_table.name: Processing Table
enc.drogas.equip.processing_table.text: Assembly bench: combines up to 3 ingredients into finished products. Uses no fuel.
enc.drogas.equip.chemistry_bench.name: Chemistry Bench
enc.drogas.equip.chemistry_bench.text: Lab reactions: needs fuel and slows down when dirty. Where solvents, bases and intermediates are made.
enc.drogas.equip.dryer.name: Dryer
enc.drogas.equip.dryer.text: Dries plants in sunlight (up to 50% faster under open sky). At night or in rain it needs fuel in its slot.
enc.drogas.equip.grinder.name: Grinder
enc.drogas.equip.grinder.text: Grinds dry matter and crystals. No fuel, but wear is fast: service it with a Maintenance Kit.
enc.drogas.equip.processing_furnace.name: Processing Furnace
enc.drogas.equip.processing_furnace.text: Ferments and cooks: fuel use grows with speed. Makes beer, wine, spirit and the ayahuasca brew.
enc.drogas.equip.storage_crate.name: Storage Crate
enc.drogas.equip.storage_crate.text: 27-slot container. Items of different quality do not stack.
enc.drogas.equip.greenhouse_regulator.te: With fuel and water, plants under glass within 6 blocks get ideal climate, minimum light and 50% faster growth.
enc.drogas.equip.trellis.name: Trellis
enc.drogas.equip.trellis.text: Support for climbers. Jagube vines climb any solid face; the trellis is the easiest to provide.
enc.drogas.equip.organic_substrate.name: Organic Substrate
enc.drogas.equip.organic_substrate.text: Fertile mushroom substrate: ideal climate and faster growth than mycelium or podzol.
enc.drogas.equip.speed_module.name: Speed Modules
enc.drogas.equip.speed_module.text: 3-tier upgrades (x1.5, x2, x3) for the upgrade slot. Faster machine, more fuel and wear. Tier III may lower quality.
enc.drogas.equip.maintenance_kit.name: Maintenance Kit
enc.drogas.equip.maintenance_kit.text: Right-click a machine to remove 60% of its wear. Worn machines slow down, produce worse and finally stop.
enc.drogas.equip.emergency_kit.name: Emergency Kit
enc.drogas.equip.emergency_kit.text: Stops an overdose or bad trip and reduces accumulated load. Leaves brief weakness.
enc.drogas.equip.detox_tonic.name: Detox Tonic
enc.drogas.equip.detox_tonic.text: Speeds recovery: lowers dependence and tolerance for every substance.
enc.drogas.equip.organic_fertilizer.name: Organic Fertilizer
enc.drogas.equip.organic_fertilizer.text: Use on a plant: raises vigor and eases stress, improving harvest quality.
enc.drogas.sub.cannabis.name: Cannabis
enc.drogas.sub.cannabis.text: Mild, long relaxant. Light regeneration in exchange for slowness and hunger.
enc.drogas.sub.cocaine.name: Cocaine
enc.drogas.sub.cocaine.text: Short aggressive stimulant: faster movement and mining; racing heart and fast tolerance.
enc.drogas.sub.crack.name: Crack
enc.drogas.sub.crack.text: Smoked, intense version: very short peak, extreme dependence and high overdose risk.
enc.drogas.sub.lsd.name: LSD
enc.drogas.sub.lsd.text: Long-lasting psychedelic: visual distortion and extended reach. No dependence, very fast tolerance.
enc.drogas.sub.psilocybin.name: Magic Mushrooms
enc.drogas.sub.psilocybin.text: Mushroom with wavy vision and heightened perception; nausea at the start.
enc.drogas.sub.opium.name: Opium
enc.drogas.sub.opium.text: Sedative resin: armor and regeneration for slowness and moderate dependence.
enc.drogas.sub.morphine.name: Morphine
enc.drogas.sub.morphine.text: Strong painkiller: better protection and regeneration, with real dependence.
enc.drogas.sub.heroin.name: Heroin
enc.drogas.sub.heroin.text: Maximum protection and tunnel vision; extreme dependence and severe withdrawal.
enc.drogas.sub.meth.name: Methamphetamine
enc.drogas.sub.meth.text: Long stimulant: speed, damage and mining; intense hunger and a 'crash' in withdrawal.
enc.drogas.sub.mdma.name: Ecstasy (MDMA)
enc.drogas.sub.mdma.text: Entactogen: euphoria, light speed and regeneration; the body charges hunger and heat.
enc.drogas.sub.ketamine.name: Ketamine
enc.drogas.sub.ketamine.text: Dissociative: safe falls and tunnel vision; slow and dangerous mixed with depressants.
enc.drogas.sub.dmt.name: DMT
enc.drogas.sub.dmt.text: Brief extreme experience: nearly immobilizes. Very high bad-trip risk.
enc.drogas.sub.ayahuasca.name: Ayahuasca
enc.drogas.sub.ayahuasca.text: Long brew: nausea purge, then night vision and extended reach.
enc.drogas.sub.tobacco.name: Tobacco
enc.drogas.sub.tobacco.text: Mild boost to mining and attack; moderate dependence.
enc.drogas.sub.alcohol.name: Alcohol
enc.drogas.sub.alcohol.text: Damage and knockback resistance, but staggering. Doses add up; dangerous with opioids.
enc.drogas.sub.nebulon.name: Nebulon (synthetic)
enc.drogas.sub.nebulon.text: Fictional synthetic: speed, high jump and safe falls; hunger and tremor.
enc.drogas.sub.zyrax.name: Zyrax (synthetic)
enc.drogas.sub.zyrax.text: Fictional tank synthetic: high armor and damage, but very slow.

enc.drogas.guide.intro.name: Introduction
enc.drogas.guide.intro.text: This encyclopedia only records what you discover. Explore abandoned structures, read documents, grow, process and use. Everything is fictional and game-only.
enc.drogas.guide.climate.name: Climate and Biomes
enc.drogas.guide.climate.text: Each plant has ideal and tolerated climates (humid, temperate, arid, cold). Outside them it stresses and may die. Greenhouses ignore climate.
enc.drogas.guide.light_water.name: Light and Water
enc.drogas.guide.light_water.text: Outside its light range a plant stops growing. Without nearby water (or on dry soil) it loses vigor.
enc.drogas.guide.quality.name: Quality
enc.drogas.guide.quality.text: Quality (Poor, Standard, Good, Excellent) comes from plant vigor and machine condition. Better = stronger, longer, cleaner; worse = impurities and easier overdose.
enc.drogas.guide.tolerance.name: Tolerance
enc.drogas.guide.tolerance.text: Repeated use of a substance reduces its effect (up to 75%). Tolerance slowly falls while you stay clean.
enc.drogas.guide.dependence.name: Dependence
enc.drogas.guide.dependence.text: Addictive substances build dependence. The higher it is, the earlier and stronger withdrawal hits when you stop.
enc.drogas.guide.withdrawal.name: Withdrawal
enc.drogas.guide.withdrawal.text: Has 3 levels and substance-specific symptoms. Using relieves it but feeds the cycle; enduring it slowly lowers dependence.
enc.drogas.guide.overdose.name: Overdose and Bad Trip
enc.drogas.guide.overdose.text: Each dose adds load that decays over time. Passing the limit causes overdose (damage) or a bad trip. Opioids + alcohol and stimulants stack risk. Use the Emergency Kit.
enc.drogas.guide.maintenance.name: Maintenance
enc.drogas.guide.maintenance.text: Machines wear with each product: dirty ones slow down, worn ones produce worse, broken ones stop. Use the Maintenance Kit.
enc.drogas.guide.greenhouse.name: Greenhouses
enc.drogas.guide.greenhouse.text: A working greenhouse = glass overhead + an active Greenhouse Regulator (fuel and water) within 6 blocks. Ideal climate, minimum light, faster growth.
enc.drogas.guide.exploration.name: Exploration
enc.drogas.guide.exploration.text: Abandoned labs, greenhouses, researcher houses and depots hold seeds, materials, equipment and documents. Field notes reveal entries.
enc.drogas.guide.safety.name: Safety
enc.drogas.guide.safety.text: Everything is fictional, but the game punishes abuse: space your doses, watch your load and carry an Emergency Kit.
